meta.title: About Lunia | Riyadh's Skin Quality Center
meta.description: Lunia is a Skin Quality Center in Riyadh built on a Korean-inspired, diagnostic-first philosophy — not a facial menu. Our story, our approach, and the journey behind every visit.

hero.heading: Skin quality is our whole philosophy
hero.intro: We didn't set out to build another spa. Lunia exists because Riyadh needed a place that treats skin, hair, and recovery with the seriousness of a real diagnosis — not a menu of quick fixes.

story.heading: Why we started Lunia
paragraphs: Lunia began with a simple frustration: too many facials, too few real results. Clients would leave glowing for a weekend and be back where they started within a week, because nothing about the treatment was calibrated to what their skin actually needed.

We looked instead to the Korean approach to skin care, where diagnosis comes before treatment and consistency matters more than any single session. That became our founding idea: read the skin first, personalize everything after, and measure quality over months, not days.

Today Lunia is three departments working from the same philosophy — Skin Quality, Hair & Scalp, and Post-Surgery Recovery — each diagnostic-led, each built to sustain a result rather than chase a moment.

positioning.heading: A facial is a moment. Skin quality is a practice.
positioning.body: A facial can make skin glow for a weekend. Skin quality is what holds after that — built through an accurate diagnosis, a personalized plan, and a rhythm of visits that compounds instead of resetting. That distinction shapes every protocol at Lunia, across skin, hair and scalp, and post-surgery recovery.

team.intro: Every treatment at Lunia is delivered by a dedicated specialist trained in our diagnostic-first approach, from the first skin read to the last maintenance visit.

items.q: Do I need to know which treatment I need before booking?
items.a: No — every visit starts with a diagnostic read of your skin or scalp. We recommend the right treatment from that, not the other way around.

items.q: How many sessions will I need?
items.a: It depends on what the diagnostic finds. Skin quality is built over a rhythm of visits, and your specialist maps that plan with you after your first consultation.

items.q: Is this only for concerns, or is it preventative too?
items.a: Both. Many clients come in for maintenance once their skin or scalp quality is where they want it — consistency is what keeps results from fading.
